CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.TstKsiStanyKont @PoczatekC int, @KoniecC int AS
set nocount on
create table #StanyKont_Stany (KKS_GIDNumer int, KKS_SynNumer int, KKS_Konto varchar(30), KKS_Poziom smallint, KKS_Rozrachunkowe smallint, KKS_Analityka smallint, KKS_SaldoWgObr smallint, KKS_TypKonta smallint, KKS_Archiwalne smallint, Rok smallint, Miesiac smallint, BODT decimal(15,2), BOCT decimal(15,2), ODTP decimal(15,2), OCTP decimal(15,2), SDTP decimal(15,2), SCTP decimal(15,2), ODT decimal(15,2), OCT decimal(15,2), ODTK decimal(15,2), OCTK decimal(15,2), SDT decimal(15,2), SCT decimal(15,2), SDTK decimal(15,2), SCTK decimal(15,2) PRIMARY KEY (KKS_GIDNumer, Rok, Miesiac) )
create table #StanyKont_Dekrety (KKS_GIDNumer int, KKS_SynNumer int, KKS_Konto varchar(30), KKS_Poziom smallint, KKS_Rozrachunkowe smallint, KKS_Analityka smallint, KKS_SaldoWgObr smallint, KKS_TypKonta smallint, KKS_Archiwalne smallint, Rok smallint, Miesiac smallint, BODT decimal(15,2), BOCT decimal(15,2), ODTP decimal(15,2), OCTP decimal(15,2), SDTP decimal(15,2), SCTP decimal(15,2), ODT decimal(15,2), OCT decimal(15,2), ODTK decimal(15,2), OCTK decimal(15,2), SDT decimal(15,2), SCT decimal(15,2), SDTK decimal(15,2), SCTK decimal(15,2) PRIMARY KEY (KKS_GIDNumer, Rok, Miesiac) )
DECLARE cursMiesiace CURSOR READ_ONLY FOR Select OkM_OkrID, Okr_Poczatek, Okr_Koniec, OkM_Rok, OkM_Miesiac, OkM_MiesiacOd, OkM_MiesiacDo from cdn.OkresyMiesiace join cdn.Okresy on OkM_OkrID = Okr_ID where ((@KoniecC <> 0 and OkM_MiesiacOd between @PoczatekC and @KoniecC) or (@KoniecC = 0 and OkM_MiesiacOd >= @PoczatekC))
OPEN cursMiesiace
declare @OkM_OkrID int declare @OkM_Rok smallint declare @OkM_Miesiac smallint declare @OkM_MiesiacOd int declare @OkM_MiesiacDo int declare @Okr_Poczatek int declare @Okr_Koniec int
FETCH NEXT FROM cursMiesiace INTO @OkM_OkrID, @Okr_Poczatek, @Okr_Koniec, @OkM_Rok, @OkM_Miesiac, @OkM_MiesiacOd, @OkM_MiesiacDo WHILE (@@fetch_status <> -1) BEGIN IF (@@fetch_status <> -2) BEGIN
insert into #StanyKont_Stany exec cdn.OOSEx_StanyKonto @Konto = '%', @Bufor = 1, @OkresIDPoczatek = @OkM_OkrID, @PoczRok = @OkM_Rok, @PoczMiesiac = @OkM_Miesiac, @KoniecRok = @OkM_Rok, @KoniecMiesiac = @OkM_Miesiac
insert into #StanyKont_Dekrety exec cdn.OOSEx_BiezKonto @Konto = '%', @Bufor = 1, @PoczatekOOPoczC = @Okr_Poczatek, @KoniecOOPoczC = @Okr_Koniec, @OkresIDKoniec = @OkM_OkrID, @PoczatekC = @OkM_MiesiacOd, @KoniecC = @OkM_MiesiacDo
update #StanyKont_Stany set Rok = @OkM_Rok, Miesiac = @OkM_Miesiac where isnull(Rok, 0) = 0
update #StanyKont_Dekrety set Rok = @OkM_Rok, Miesiac = @OkM_Miesiac where isnull(Rok, 0) = 0
END FETCH NEXT FROM cursMiesiace INTO @OkM_OkrID, @Okr_Poczatek, @Okr_Koniec, @OkM_Rok, @OkM_Miesiac, @OkM_MiesiacOd, @OkM_MiesiacDo END
CLOSE cursMiesiace
if exists( select a.KKS_GIDNumer, a.Rok, a.Miesiac from #StanyKont_Stany a join #StanyKont_Dekrety b on a.KKS_GIDNumer = b.KKS_GIDNumer and a.Rok = b.Rok and a.Miesiac = b.Miesiac where a.ODT <> b.ODT or a.OCT <> b.OCT or a.ODTK <> b.ODTK or a.OCTK <> b.OCTK ) begin select k.KKS_Konto, k.KKS_GIDNumer, a.Rok, a.Miesiac from #StanyKont_Stany a join #StanyKont_Dekrety b on a.KKS_GIDNumer = b.KKS_GIDNumer and a.Rok = b.Rok and a.Miesiac = b.Miesiac join cdn.Konta k on a.KKS_GIDNumer = k.KKS_GIDNumer where a.ODT <> b.ODT or a.OCT <> b.OCT or a.ODTK <> b.ODTK or a.OCTK <> b.OCTK
end else begin delete from #StanyKont_Stany delete from #StanyKont_Dekrety
OPEN cursMiesiace
FETCH NEXT FROM cursMiesiace INTO @OkM_OkrID, @Okr_Poczatek, @Okr_Koniec, @OkM_Rok, @OkM_Miesiac, @OkM_MiesiacOd, @OkM_MiesiacDo WHILE (@@fetch_status <> -1) BEGIN IF (@@fetch_status <> -2) BEGIN
insert into #StanyKont_Stany exec cdn.OOSEx_StanyKonto @Konto = '%', @Bufor = 0, @OkresIDPoczatek = @OkM_OkrID, @PoczRok = @OkM_Rok, @PoczMiesiac = @OkM_Miesiac, @KoniecRok = @OkM_Rok, @KoniecMiesiac = @OkM_Miesiac
insert into #StanyKont_Dekrety exec cdn.OOSEx_BiezKonto @Konto = '%', @Bufor = 0, @PoczatekOOPoczC = @Okr_Poczatek, @KoniecOOPoczC = @Okr_Koniec, @OkresIDKoniec = @OkM_OkrID, @PoczatekC = @OkM_MiesiacOd, @KoniecC = @OkM_MiesiacDo
update #StanyKont_Stany set Rok = @OkM_Rok, Miesiac = @OkM_Miesiac where isnull(Rok, 0) = 0
update #StanyKont_Dekrety set Rok = @OkM_Rok, Miesiac = @OkM_Miesiac where isnull(Rok, 0) = 0
END FETCH NEXT FROM cursMiesiace INTO @OkM_OkrID, @Okr_Poczatek, @Okr_Koniec, @OkM_Rok, @OkM_Miesiac, @OkM_MiesiacOd, @OkM_MiesiacDo END
CLOSE cursMiesiace
select k.KKS_Konto, k.KKS_GIDNumer, a.Rok, a.Miesiac from #StanyKont_Stany a join #StanyKont_Dekrety b on a.KKS_GIDNumer = b.KKS_GIDNumer and a.Rok = b.Rok and a.Miesiac = b.Miesiac join cdn.Konta k on a.KKS_GIDNumer = k.KKS_GIDNumer where a.ODT <> b.ODT or a.OCT <> b.OCT or a.ODTK <> b.ODTK or a.OCTK <> b.OCTK end
DEALLOCATE cursMiesiace
drop table #StanyKont_Stany drop table #StanyKont_Dekrety
set nocount off
